parsed.brief_reason: The patch makes two problematic changes: (1) removing the minValue update in getPivotColumn breaks the pivot selection logic by always comparing against 0 instead of tracking the most negative value, and (2) adding artificial variable row subtraction in getSolution is unexplained and appears to be a workaround rather than fixing the root cause. These changes are overfitted to pass the specific test case rather than addressing the underlying bug correctly.
